title: The Permission Summary is grouped and shows each setting's on/off state
preconds: 1. A Permission Summary is open for Service Manager.
steps:
1. Scroll through the window.
  2. For the add/edit/delete areas, check how the state is shown.
  3. For the toggles, check how the state is shown.
  4. For View mode, check how the value is shown.
expected:
Every setting is clearly labelled with its on/off state.

The content is grouped into the add/edit/delete areas, the Page Access toggles, the Settings sub-toggles, the Work orders sub-settings (View mode, Review work orders, Pick parts, Order parts), and the Cross-Cutting Toggles (See Financial Data, View and Manage AP/AR Data, View History Logs).
